name: my-invest
description: Value-investing research for US-listed stocks from plain questions: analyze one or more tickers (price outlook at 1/2/5/10 years, buy and sell zones with timing, reasons, strengths and weaknesses, options context, holdings gains and Canadian tax treatment, a labelled short-term lens, charts), find stocks for a horizon and strategy, and a daily or weekly digest over every stock asked about. Every figure carries a source URL and date, enforced by a lint script; each ticker's dossier grows with every question.
